title: Work with your Financial Reports in a Spreadsheet inside Business Central (Advanced Spreadsheets)

chapters.title: Opening Financial Reports in Spreadsheet View
Live Report Calculations and Spreadsheet Functionality
Live Data Updates and Distribution Options

features.name: Open Financial Reports as Spreadsheet
features.description: Users can open financial reports from Business Central and export them as spreadsheets using the open as a spreadsheet function, making the data more accessible and easier to work with.

features.name: Spreadsheet Slicers for Filtering
features.description: Financial report spreadsheets include slicers for dimensions like period, department, customer group, and region, allowing users to filter data directly within the spreadsheet interface.

features.name: Live Report Calculations in Spreadsheet
features.description: Financial reports run as live calculations within the spreadsheet, recalculating automatically when filters are applied or changes are made, providing real-time data rather than a static point-in-time snapshot.

features.name: Spreadsheet Editing and Calculation Capabilities
features.description: Users can edit values within the spreadsheet and perform calculations directly, treating the financial report as a standard spreadsheet while maintaining its underlying live data connection.

features.name: Combining Multiple Financial Reports
features.description: Users can combine multiple financial reports with other data using the advanced spreadsheet app to create custom presentations for users, with formatting options available.

features.name: Live Data Distribution to Users
features.description: Financial report spreadsheets can be distributed to different users and will recalculate with live data whenever opened, ensuring users always see current data.

features.name: Automatic Date-Based Slicer Updates
features.description: Date slicers in financial report spreadsheets automatically update as time progresses, ensuring reports remain valid for current and future periods without manual updates.
